extracted.intended_audience: general readers, researchers, journalists, and Wikipedia editors
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia encyclopedia article summarising the 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB) scandal, its background, investigations, and international ramifications. The page is written for general reference and for editors who maintain/update Wikipedia content.

rubrics_metrics.name: This article needs to be updated
rubrics_metrics.description: This article needs to be updated. The reason given is: Question as to whether or not this is still ongoing. Please help update this article to reflect recent events or newly available information. (November 2025)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintenance tag requesting editors to bring the article up to date — i.e., add recent events, new findings, or developments and update timeline/status statements; includes timestamp indicating when the request was added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use British English
rubrics_metrics.description: Use British English from December 2016 / All Wikipedia articles written in British English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article should follow British English spelling, usage, and regional conventions consistently (e.g., 'organisation' vs 'organization').

rubrics_metrics.name: Use dmy dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates in the article should be formatted day-month-year (dmy) consistently (e.g., '25 December 2019').

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles in need of updating / vague or ambiguous time
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia articles in need of updating from November 2025; All articles with vague or ambiguous time / Vague or ambiguous time from October 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid vague or ambiguous time references (e.g., 'recently', 'currently'); replace with specific dates or timeframes and cite reliable sources. Ensure content reflects clear chronological framing and current status where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description differs from Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description is different from Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where applicable, reconcile or justify differences between the article's short description and the corresponding Wikidata short description, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
